## EventResourceClient.update() method

Update an existing event within a parent scope. When several calendars share the same name, the first match in the app's order is used as the calendar.

**Signature:**

```typescript
update(calendarId: string, id: string, input: EventUpdateInput, __mactsOptions?: _macts_contracts.CallOptions): Promise<Event>;
```
